title: carreterinas
description: api (carreterinas), sqlite y usuarios reales (carreterinas-web): trazas, logs y métricas de @platform/observability

panels.title: Requests
panels.description: Requests http atendidas por la api.

queries.query: SELECT count(*) AS value FROM "default" WHERE service_name = 'carreterinas' AND span_kind = '2'

panels.title: 5xx
panels.description: Requests que acabaron en error de servidor.

queries.query: SELECT count(*) AS value FROM "default" WHERE service_name = 'carreterinas' AND span_kind = '2' AND span_status = 'ERROR'

panels.title: p95 (ms)
panels.description: Percentil 95 de las requests (trazas).

queries.query: SELECT approx_percentile_cont(duration, 0.95) / 1000 AS value FROM "default" WHERE service_name = 'carreterinas' AND span_kind = '2'

panels.title: Logs de error
panels.description: Errores de la api (carreterinas) y del cliente (carreterinas-web).

queries.query: SELECT count(*) AS value FROM "default" WHERE service_name IN ('carreterinas', 'carreterinas-web') AND severity = 'ERROR'

panels.title: Requests/s
panels.description: Tráfico total y 5xx (métrica http.server.request.duration).

queries.query: sum(rate(http_server_request_duration_count{service_name="carreterinas"}[5m]))
sum(rate(http_server_request_duration_count{service_name="carreterinas",http_response_status_code=~"5.."}[5m]))

panels.title: Latencia (s)
panels.description: Percentiles de duración de las requests.

queries.query: histogram_quantile(0.5, sum by (le) (rate(http_server_request_duration_bucket{service_name="carreterinas"}[5m])))
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le) (rate(http_server_request_duration_bucket{service_name="carreterinas"}[5m])))
histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by (le) (rate(http_server_request_duration_bucket{service_name="carreterinas"}[5m])))

panels.title: Memoria
panels.description: Memoria residente (rss) y heap de v8 en uso.

queries.query: max(process_memory_usage{service_name="carreterinas"})
max(v8js_memory_heap_used{service_name="carreterinas"})

panels.title: Lag del event loop p99 (s)
panels.description: Si sube, algo síncrono (una query, un cálculo) bloquea el proceso.

queries.query: max(nodejs_eventloop_delay_p99{service_name="carreterinas"})

panels.title: Endpoints
panels.description: Por p95, con volumen y errores (trazas).

queries.query: SELECT http_route, count(*) AS requests, approx_percentile_cont(duration, 0.5) / 1000 AS p50_ms, approx_percentile_cont(duration, 0.95) / 1000 AS p95_ms, sum(CASE WHEN span_status = 'ERROR' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS errores FROM "default" WHERE service_name = 'carreterinas' AND span_kind = '2' AND http_route IS NOT NULL GROUP BY http_route ORDER BY p95_ms DESC LIMIT 50

panels.title: Últimos errores
panels.description: Copia el trace_id en Traces para ver la request entera.

queries.query: SELECT _timestamp, service_name, scope, body, trace_id FROM "default" WHERE service_name IN ('carreterinas', 'carreterinas-web') AND severity = 'ERROR' ORDER BY _timestamp DESC LIMIT 50

panels.title: Queries/s
panels.description: Sentencias sqlite por segundo (5m).

queries.query: sum(rate(db_client_operation_duration_count{service_name="carreterinas"}[5m]))

panels.title: p95 query (s)
panels.description: Percentil 95 de las sentencias (5m).

queries.query: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le) (rate(db_client_operation_duration_bucket{service_name="carreterinas"}[5m])))

panels.title: Errores de sqlite
panels.description: Sentencias fallidas (incluye busy/locked: escrituras que no consiguen el lock).

queries.query: SELECT count(*) AS value FROM "default" WHERE service_name = 'carreterinas' AND db_system_name = 'sqlite' AND span_status = 'ERROR'

panels.title: Queries lentas
panels.description: Sentencias por encima de DB_SLOW_QUERY_MS (100 por defecto).

queries.query: SELECT count(*) AS value FROM "default" WHERE service_name = 'carreterinas' AND scope = 'db' AND body LIKE 'query lenta%'

panels.title: Queries/s por operación
panels.description: SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE...

queries.query: sum by (db_operation_name) (rate(db_client_operation_duration_count{service_name="carreterinas"}[5m]))

panels.title: p95 por tabla (s)
panels.description: Qué tablas tardan más.

queries.query: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, db_collection_name) (rate(db_client_operation_duration_bucket{service_name="carreterinas"}[5m])))

panels.title: SQL por tiempo total
panels.description: Hotspots: sentencias (con ?) por tiempo acumulado (las que corren dentro de una traza).

queries.query: SELECT db_query_text, count(*) AS llamadas, sum(duration) / 1000 AS total_ms, avg(duration) / 1000 AS media_ms, max(duration) / 1000 AS max_ms FROM "default" WHERE service_name = 'carreterinas' AND db_system_name = 'sqlite' GROUP BY db_query_text ORDER BY total_ms DESC LIMIT 30

panels.title: Sospechosas de n+1
panels.description: Sentencias que se repiten muchas veces dentro de una misma traza.

queries.query: SELECT db_query_text, count(*) AS llamadas, count(DISTINCT trace_id) AS trazas, count(*) / count(DISTINCT trace_id) AS por_traza FROM "default" WHERE service_name = 'carreterinas' AND db_system_name = 'sqlite' GROUP BY db_query_text HAVING count(*) / count(DISTINCT trace_id) >= 5 ORDER BY por_traza DESC LIMIT 30

panels.title: Queries lentas
panels.description: Log [db] query lenta: también las de fuera de una traza (pollers, arranque).

queries.query: SELECT _timestamp, duration_ms, db_query_text, trace_id FROM "default" WHERE service_name = 'carreterinas' AND scope = 'db' AND body LIKE 'query lenta%' ORDER BY _timestamp DESC LIMIT 50

panels.title: Errores de sqlite
panels.description: Con su mensaje (SQLITE_BUSY / database is locked = contención de escritura).

queries.query: SELECT _timestamp, operation_name, status_message, db_query_text, trace_id FROM "default" WHERE service_name = 'carreterinas' AND db_system_name = 'sqlite' AND span_status = 'ERROR' ORDER BY _timestamp DESC LIMIT 50

panels.title: Sesiones
panels.description: Cargas de página distintas (session.id) en web y apps.

queries.query: SELECT count(DISTINCT session_id) AS value FROM "default" WHERE service_name = 'carreterinas-web'

panels.title: Usuarios
panels.description: Usuarios con sesión iniciada (user.id lo resuelve el servidor).

queries.query: SELECT count(DISTINCT user_id) AS value FROM "default" WHERE service_name = 'carreterinas-web'

panels.title: Errores del cliente
panels.description: Excepciones, rechazos sin handler y chunks que no cargan.

queries.query: SELECT count(*) AS value FROM "default" WHERE service_name = 'carreterinas-web' AND severity = 'ERROR'

panels.title: Carga p75 (ms)
panels.description: Desde el inicio de la navegación hasta la primera ruta pintada.

queries.query: SELECT approx_percentile_cont(duration, 0.75) / 1000 AS value FROM "default" WHERE service_name = 'carreterinas-web' AND operation_name LIKE 'pageload%'

panels.title: Web vitals
panels.description: p75 y % poor por ruta de aterrizaje. good: LCP < 2500 ms, INP < 200 ms, CLS < 0.1, FCP < 1800 ms, TTFB < 800 ms.

queries.query: SELECT web_vital_name, app_route, count(*) AS muestras, approx_percentile_cont(web_vital_value, 0.75) AS p75, round(sum(CASE WHEN web_vital_rating = 'poor' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / count(*)) AS pct_poor FROM "default" WHERE service_name = 'carreterinas-web' AND scope = 'web-vitals' GROUP BY web_vital_name, app_route ORDER BY web_vital_name, muestras DESC LIMIT 100

panels.title: La api vista desde el cliente
panels.description: Latencia que nota el usuario (red incluida). 5xx = la api respondió con error; sin respuesta = fallo de red o petición cancelada (firefox cancela así las de una recarga).

queries.query: SELECT operation_name, count(*) AS llamadas, approx_percentile_cont(duration, 0.5) / 1000 AS p50_ms, approx_percentile_cont(duration, 0.95) / 1000 AS p95_ms, sum(CASE WHEN http_response_status_code >= 500 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS e5xx, sum(CASE WHEN status_message LIKE 'network:%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS sin_respuesta FROM "default" WHERE service_name = 'carreterinas-web' AND span_kind = '3' AND operation_name NOT LIKE '% /_app/%' GROUP BY operation_name ORDER BY p95_ms DESC LIMIT 50

panels.title: Carga y navegaciones p75 (ms)
panels.description: pageload (arranque de la spa) y navigate (cambio de ruta).

queries.query: SELECT histogram(_timestamp) AS x_axis_1, approx_percentile_cont(duration, 0.75) / 1000 AS y_axis_1, CASE WHEN operation_name LIKE 'pageload%' THEN 'pageload' ELSE 'navigate' END AS breakdown_1 FROM "default" WHERE service_name = 'carreterinas-web' AND span_kind = '1' GROUP BY x_axis_1, breakdown_1 ORDER BY x_axis_1

panels.title: Errores del cliente
panels.description: Por plataforma.

queries.query: SELECT histogram(_timestamp) AS x_axis_1, count(*) AS y_axis_1, app_platform AS breakdown_1 FROM "default" WHERE service_name = 'carreterinas-web' AND severity = 'ERROR' GROUP BY x_axis_1, breakdown_1 ORDER BY x_axis_1

panels.title: Errores del cliente agrupados
panels.description: Por mensaje, ruta, build y plataforma; el stack (simbolizado) está en el log.

queries.query: SELECT body, app_route, service_version, app_platform, count(*) AS veces, count(DISTINCT session_id) AS sesiones, max(_timestamp) AS ultimo FROM "default" WHERE service_name = 'carreterinas-web' AND severity = 'ERROR' GROUP BY body, app_route, service_version, app_platform ORDER BY veces DESC LIMIT 50

panels.title: Navegaciones
panels.description: pageload y navigate por ruta, p75.

queries.query: SELECT operation_name, count(*) AS veces, approx_percentile_cont(duration, 0.75) / 1000 AS p75_ms, max(duration) / 1000 AS max_ms FROM "default" WHERE service_name = 'carreterinas-web' AND span_kind = '1' GROUP BY operation_name ORDER BY p75_ms DESC LIMIT 50

panels.title: Plataformas y builds
panels.description: Sesiones por plataforma (web, ios, android) y versión del bundle.

queries.query: SELECT app_platform, service_version, count(DISTINCT session_id) AS sesiones, count(DISTINCT user_id) AS usuarios FROM "default" WHERE service_name = 'carreterinas-web' GROUP BY app_platform, service_version ORDER BY sesiones DESC LIMIT 30

panels.title: Navegadores
panels.description: User agent por sesiones.

queries.query: SELECT user_agent_original, count(DISTINCT session_id) AS sesiones FROM "default" WHERE service_name = 'carreterinas-web' GROUP BY user_agent_original ORDER BY sesiones DESC LIMIT 30
